title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Just Dropped Big Tease for Vegeta’s Strongest Form
content: Dragon Ball Super is currently working its way through a new remake anime series this Fall, and the newest episode is setting up a big transformation for Vegeta’s future with one of its key changes.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Anime
content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday that it will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January. Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.
author: ANN

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Crunchyroll Return for Season 3 – Watch Trailer
content: A major Shonen Jump anime has now confirmed it’s coming back to Crunchyroll with Season 3 next year, and a new trailer is helping to show it off. With the Fall 2026 anime schedule now underway, there are all sorts of new anime that are starting to be announced for a release next year.
author: ComicBook

title: Bandai Namco Announces Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3 Game for PS5, PC
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced on Wednesday during the Gundam Games 40th Anniversary livestream the new Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3 game for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Announces New Veil Lift Anime, 2nd Season of Ghost Meets Gal Mini Anime
content: The official X/Twitter account for the Cardfight!! Vanguard franchise announced on Wednesday the new Cardfight!! Vanguard Veil Lift television anime. The franchise also announced a second season for the mini anime adaptation of Kaeru DX 's Ghost Meets Gal manga .
author: ANN

title: South Park Confirms Kenny’s Replacement in New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content: South Park has dropped the first look at Season 29’s next big episode, and with it confirmed a new replacement for Kenny. South Park Season 29 kicked off its new run of episodes this year with some big changes.
author: ComicBook

title: The Greatest Magicmaster’s Retirement Plan Anime Unveils Tesfia Character Visual
content: The Greatest Magicmaster’s Retirement Plan anime unveiled a new visual featuring the character Tesfia “Fia” Fable on Wednesday. It was also announced the voice actress Eri Yukimura will voice the character. The series is set to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Digest Video
content: The upcoming Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 revealed a new premiere visual featuring the main character Mona Kawai on Wednesday. A digest video recapping the first season was also released. Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe Game Launches on October 29
content: Crypton Future Media announced on Thursday that the Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe game will launch for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store on October 29.
author: ANN

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan TV Anime Casts Eri Yukimura
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Izushiro and illustrator Ruria Miyuki 's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan ( Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku ) light novel series announced on Wednesday that the anime will air in the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels…
author: ANN
